deal_facts.account: Mac-Gray explored alternatives and approached Party A before launching organized outreach in June 2013. The banker contacted 50 prospects and 20 signed confidentiality agreements over the ensuing two months. Four bidders advanced to staged diligence, with strategic bidders receiving more restricted information than financial bidders. September 11 opened a final solicitation; Party C did not respond, while Party B offered cash plus contingent equity options and CSC offered committed all-cash funding. CSC increased to $21.25, obtained exclusivity September 24 and completed negotiations after an extension. The agreement was signed October 14 and publicly announced October 15.

future_scoring_protocol.pass: All material fields satisfied, including accepted alternatives. Equivalent compact organization receives credit.
future_scoring_protocol.partial: Only a precisely identified correct and useful part qualifies; list correct and wrong/missing fields separately. Missing evidence or event is never an automatic pass.
future_scoring_protocol.score: sum(weight * credit); locked total denominator 100 with fixed category denominators.
future_scoring_protocol.critical_errors_separate: Log material unsupported additions and serious core-variable errors separately, even outside expected tests. Never alter denominators after seeing candidates.
future_scoring_protocol.root_cause_policy: One mistaken entry/cohort/round can affect several locked practical tests; link those consequences to one upstream incident instead of describing independent incidents.
critical_error_examples: 20 aggregate NDAs plus their named members counted again
Invented C final offer or bidder re-entry
B options misrepresented as guaranteed cash
Fabricated financing commitment or sale-process termination
separate_nonprimary_dimensions: Exact field misses, omissions, duplicates and inconsistencies
Review burden: words, useful/noisy questions, checkability, edits; no claimed human review time
Alex compatibility only if supplied, no current-instruction penalty
future_scoring_protocol.mechanical_review: Four required sheets/order/headers; controlled labels; real Excel dates; nondecreasing sort keys and honest bounds; frozen/filter/wrapped headers; no merged cells; note/quote lengths; empty reviewer and unsupported numeric cells; flags tied to material Questions. Checker flags are leads, not verdicts.
future_scoring_protocol.amendments: Propose sourced amendment if reference wrong; apply original and amended scoring to all candidates. Never silently change reference.
future_scoring_protocol.scope: Stage 1 only; no candidate scores, ranking or identity inference.
